experiment_description: Measurement of the Raman spectrum of a bulk CrSBr crystal averaged over polarization angles using a 532 nm excitation laser wavelength.

Ag_1_phonon_mode_frequency.description: Frequency shift of the Ag_1 Raman mode.

Ag_2_phonon_mode_frequency.description: Frequency shift of the Ag_2 Raman mode.

Ag_3_phonon_mode_frequency.description: Frequency shift of the Ag_3 Raman mode.

experiment_description: Determination of the complete refractive index tensor of a CrSBr sample across a broadband spectral range utilizing parallel-polarized optical reflection microscopy and Kramers-Kronig relations.

exciton_resonance_energy.description: Central energy of the fundamental exciton resonance for light polarized along the crystallographic b-axis.

exciton_resonance_wavelength.description: Central wavelength of the fundamental exciton resonance for light polarized along the crystallographic b-axis.

peak_extinction_coefficient_b_axis.description: Maximum value of the extinction coefficient for light polarized along the b-axis at the exciton resonance energy.

extinction_coefficient_a_axis_at_resonan.description: Value of the extinction coefficient for light polarized along the a-axis across the exciton resonance spectral range.

peak_in_plane_birefringence.description: Peak value of the in-plane birefringence near the exciton resonance.

min_transparency_region_birefringence.description: Minimum measured in-plane birefringence in the transparency region for wavelengths greater than 1100 nm.

max_transparency_region_birefringence.description: Maximum measured in-plane birefringence in the transparency region for wavelengths greater than 1100 nm.

experiment_description: Scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM) performed in a reflection configuration on a CrSBr flake. The flake is examined at two orthogonal orientations by rotating the sample 90 degrees with respect to a 900 nm excitation laser propagation direction to assess guided modes.

TM0_mode_supported_a_axis.description: Indicates whether the TM0 guided mode is supported along the crystallographic a-axis under 900 nm excitation.

TE0_mode_supported_a_axis.description: Indicates whether the TE0 guided mode is supported along the crystallographic a-axis under 900 nm excitation.

TM0_mode_supported_b_axis.description: Indicates whether the TM0 guided mode is supported along the crystallographic b-axis under 900 nm excitation.

TE0_mode_supported_b_axis.description: Indicates whether the TE0 guided mode is supported along the crystallographic b-axis under 900 nm excitation.

experiment_description: Fabrication of a zero-order quarter-wave plate from an exfoliated CrSBr flake on a transparent CaF2 substrate. Measurement of phase retardance of transmitted light as a function of wavelength. Angle-resolved transmittance maps of transmitted intensity versus input polarizer and analyzer angles are recorded to locate conditions for uniform circular polarization output.

qwp_flake_thickness.description: Thickness of the CrSBr flake utilized for the wave plate.

qwp_operation_wavelength_1.description: First near-infrared wavelength at which a phase retardance of 90 degrees is observed.

qwp_operation_wavelength_2.description: Second near-infrared wavelength at which a phase retardance of 90 degrees is observed.

optimal_polarizer_angle_1029nm.description: Input polarizer angle setting at 1029 nm wavelength where the transmitted intensity becomes independent of the analyzer angle.

optimal_polarizer_angle_940nm.description: Input polarizer angle setting at 940 nm wavelength where the transmitted intensity becomes independent of the analyzer angle.

wavelength_to_thickness_ratio_940nm.description: Ratio of the measured operating wavelength to the measured device thickness at the 940 nm setpoint.

wavelength_to_thickness_ratio_1029nm.description: Ratio of the measured operating wavelength to the measured device thickness at the 1029 nm setpoint.
